name: Alibaba Cloud Model Studio
description: Serves Qwen and third-party models through DashScope and OpenAI-compatible APIs on Alibaba Cloud, covering text, vision, image, speech, and embeddings, plus a RAG knowledge base.

skills.name: Function Calling
skills.description: Lets Qwen models call developer-defined tools and return structured tool calls.

skills.name: Text-To-Image
skills.description: Generates images from prompts with Qwen-Image and Wan models.

skills.name: Embeddings
skills.description: Converts text into vectors with embedding models for search and retrieval.

skills.name: Knowledge Base
skills.description: Builds a knowledge base for retrieval-augmented generation in Model Studio, billed separately from inference.

skills.name: Real-Time Speech Synthesis
skills.description: Streams synthesized speech with Qwen TTS and CosyVoice models.
